pages.title: Thermal Capacitor
pages.text: An advanced heater upgrade component. Right-click on any $(l:heating/thermal_heater)Thermal Heater$(/l) to install. One per heater. Consumed on use.$(br2)$(bold)Effects:$()$(br)$(li)Doubles warmth radius$(li)Increases heat output by 50%$(li)Persists through save/load$(li)Cannot be removed once installed$(br2)A single capacitor turns a basic heater (7-block radius, +35°C) into a 14-block radius, +52°C monster. On a Diamond Heater, you're looking at a 28-block radius at +120°C.$(br2)$(italic)ORSA Engineering wanted to call it the "Thermal Amplitude Redistribution Device." Marketing called it a capacitor. Marketing won.$()
Refined Acheronite (top/bottom), Thermal Cores (sides), and a Frostbitten Core (center). It costs an arm and a leg. But your arms won't have frostbite anymore, so there's that.
